name: comprehension-guard
description: Blocks large pastes, inline AI insertions, and AI coding-agent edits behind a quick comprehension check, so you understand code before it lands in your file.

commands.title: Comprehension Guard: Bypass Next Insertion (deadline escape hatch)
Comprehension Guard: Install AI Agent Hooks
Comprehension Guard: Delete Local Code Index
Comprehension Guard: Search Local Code Index

comprehensionGuard.enabled.description: Enable the comprehension check on large pastes and inline insertions.

comprehensionGuard.charThreshold.description: Minimum number of characters in a single paste, inline insertion, or AI-agent edit before the comprehension check is triggered.

comprehensionGuard.minAnswerLength.description: Minimum length of an explanation (in characters) required to pass the comprehension check.

comprehensionGuard.provider.description: LLM provider for question generation and grading. ollama is local. The *-cli providers use an installed, signed-in coding CLI and do not need an API key.

comprehensionGuard.model.description: Model id. Leave empty to use a sensible mid-tier default for the provider. Do not use nano/mini tiers for grading.

comprehensionGuard.gradingMode.description: Grading mode: free-text LLM-as-judge or deterministic multiple-choice.

comprehensionGuard.nonCriticalPassFracti.description: Fraction of non-critical criteria that must pass (all critical criteria must always pass).

comprehensionGuard.misgradeReportUrl.description: Optional URL that receives a JSON POST when a student marks a grade as wrong. Reports are always saved on the computer.

comprehensionGuard.supabaseUrl.description: Supabase project URL. Used only to sync mastery, recall cards, profile, and the file knowledge map.

comprehensionGuard.supabaseAnonKey.description: Supabase anon key. The session token is stored in SecretStorage, not this setting.

comprehensionGuard.mode.description: auto uses a walkthrough only for a large multi-file agent change. learn always uses one check. walkthrough always walks through multi-file agent changes.

comprehensionGuard.walkthroughFileThresh.description: In auto mode, start a walkthrough when an agent changes at least this many files.

comprehensionGuard.walkthroughLineThresh.description: In auto mode, start a walkthrough when an agent change adds at least this many lines.

comprehensionGuard.maxFollowups.description: Maximum number of follow-up questions before a final decision.

comprehensionGuard.agentPause.description: Pause an AI agent after each chunk until that chunk's question is answered correctly.

comprehensionGuard.checkPreset.description: Which question types a chunk can use. Quick stays on multiple choice and ordering. Standard adds predict and explain. Deep can ask for a change.

comprehensionGuard.preferredLanguage.description: Language the student wants to answer chunk questions in. Leave blank to use the profile.

comprehensionGuard.strictness.description: Lenient always asks multiple choice. Standard follows the preset and mastery. Strict asks the deepest question the preset allows. An exam or interview within 14 days steps the preset up.

comprehensionGuard.desktopSyncEnabled.description: Opt in to sending new quiz questions, answers, feedback, and assessment results to the paired desktop app on this computer. Turning off pauses delivery and retains pending records. Does not change Supabase sync.

scripts.test:unit: npm run test:network && npm run test:claude-walkthrough
